parole.significato: A small flat-bottomed boat with pointed or somewhat pointed ends, used for fishing both offshore and on rivers.
parole.testo: Attested in American English from 1709 C.E.; possibly derived from an indigenous language of the West Indies or Central America, perhaps Miskito.

parole.significato: A culture-bound syndrome among the Miskito people of eastern Central America, mainly affecting young women with anxiety…
parole.testo: Reborrowed from Miskito [Term?], from English crazy sickness.
